title: Exolon structured gameplay event record, schema_version 1
description: Frozen wire contract for the gameplay event log (JSON-lines, one record per line). Authoritative catalog: engineering/changes/20260924-implement-a-structured-gameplay-event-log-for-ev-32f59c/evidence/analysis-integration_architect.md sections 3, 4, 8 plus the controller rulings in brief.md (design rulings 1-8). One line = envelope (same seven keys, same order, on EVERY line) + the payload properties of that record's name. Producers and consumers are tested against this file by evidence/gameplay_log_check.py. Compatibility: adding an optional payload field or a new event name is non-breaking (names are append-only); renaming/removing a field or name, or changing a type, requires a schema_version bump, and consumers must reject an unknown major instead of mis-reading it. Field values are integers, booleans and whitelisted lowercase-ASCII labels only: there is deliberately no float, no free text and no wall-clock value anywhere except log.begin (security/PII ruling in brief.md). Because the in-memory record is a fixed 24-byte struct, several contract fields share one 16-bit lane or are derived; the exact lane map is recorded per name in x-encode and is the single authority for the Swift formatter.

x-units.quarter-pixel: integer, 1/4 logical pixel (512x384 field); divide by 4 for px
x-units.tick-derived microsecond: round(n * 1000000 / 60) for n fixed steps of GameConstants.fixedTimeStep

x-families.note: integration_architect section 3 fixes the closed family set and reserves bullet, entity, pickup, hud. The section 8 catalog it also freezes uses further prefixes: pickup.collect (wave-A packs), entity.launcher_fire (mandatory P1-6 witness, added by brief ruling 3), game.game_over (mandatory P1-8 playthrough-end marker), score.* (listed under bonus in section 8) and log.* for the four meta records, whose names are literally log.begin, log.rotate, log.events_dropped, log.end. Those names are kept verbatim rather than renamed, because renaming a frozen identifier is a schema_version bump; bullet and hud stay unused (hud.banner is out of scope per integration section 11-5).

schema_version.x-encode: literal 1 on every line; a consumer must reject any other major

seq.x-encode: event ordinal assigned by the single writer as lines are built, strictly +1 per line within (run_id, rot) and never reset inside a run. Proof of total order: a gap means records were lost or the stream was corrupted. A ring lap is NOT a gap (the writer numbers only what survives) and is declared by log.events_dropped instead, which brackets the hole with the two seq numbers it sits between.

tick.x-encode: fixed-step index; 0 is reserved for everything emitted before the first executed fixed step; the first executed step is exactly 1; process-global, never reset by transition/death/restart/pause

frame.x-encode: SKScene.update render-frame index; 0 is the first update(_:) call that returns early on previousUpdateTime == 0; the first simulated tick therefore has frame >= 1; the only key that makes P1-9 visible

rot.x-encode: rotation index within the run; 0 for the first file

ts_us.x-encode: derived, never measured and never accumulated: round(tick * 1000000 / 60). Accumulating the rounded constant 16667 us drifts +12 ms by tick 36000

name.x-encode: <family>.<object>_<verb>, lowercase ASCII, one dot, at most 40 chars; unknown enum raw values format as unknown<N> and never alias a real name (see x-unknown-name)

wall_utc.x-note: the only wall-clock field in the contract; human correlation only, never an ordering key

seed.x-note: RNG seed if the run pins one, else the literal nondeterministic; there are 16 unseeded Int.random sites in gameplay, so streams are not reproducible and predicates must stay causal

level.x-note: 0 = meta/state/tick anomalies; 1 = + input edges, player actions, damage, bonus, score, pickup, entity, game; 2 = + player.motion every tick (regression tests)

x-unknown-name.description: A record whose kind raw value has no entry in this catalog is formatted as unknown<N> where N is the raw value, and carries no payload. Appending a case is non-breaking; renumbering an existing case is not.

x-code-tables.note: Single source of truth for wire labels is the existing Swift vocabulary (integration section 3: never invent a second one). Evidence/harness prints these tables to contract.txt and gameplay_log_check.py diffs them against this file.
x-code-tables.x-extension-rule: a new stage_component_id (wave D's bravery/timed ladder) must be appended here, to GameplayStageComponent and to GameplayStageComponentSequence in the SAME commit: envelope_schema_valid rejects an id this enum does not declare, and gameplay_log_check's predicate_b takes its allowed ids from this list, so the schema stays the single authority.

allOf.x-encode: writer-built, once per file, first line: run_id,build,wall_utc,level,path,seed,zone=0,flow_state

then.x-note: placement: the LAST line of the retired file (before that file's final flush), so a consumer holding only that generation can tell a rotation from a truncation. Envelope rot names the retired generation; payload rot names the incoming one that continues seq.

allOf.x-encode: writer-built, LAST line of the retired file (so that generation is distinguishable from a truncation); envelope rot names the retired generation, payload rot the incoming one that continues seq

first_seq.x-note: seq of the first record written after this line

last_seq.x-note: seq of the last record written before the loss

ring_capacity.x-note: ring slots, so a reader can size the backlog

marker.x-note: the human-greppable marker, kept inside valid JSON because every line must parse

allOf.x-encode: writer-built, emitted in front of the batch it brackets: last_seq/first_seq name records that exist on both sides of the loss window
writer-built, last line of the live file: events is the producer-side count, so events minus body records minus declared drops == a lost tail
